summary: Save the church's public Facebook Page and optional Meta Pixel identifiers in Shepherd. This first version is a settings-only foundation; it does not connect an account, load Meta scripts, embed a feed, or send tracking events.

sections.title: What to enter
sections.content: Add the public Facebook Page URL when available. Page ID and Meta Pixel ID are optional numeric identifiers. No Facebook password, access token, or account credentials are required or stored.

sections.title: Current status: inactive
sections.content: The plugin is disabled by default. Saving settings or enabling the plugin does not turn on tracking or modify the public website. Page association, embedded content, and consent-aware public-site tracking will be implemented and verified after access is available. CRM member records, login, signup, and editing pages must remain outside any future Pixel tracking scope.

sections.title: Page connection and Pixel are separate
sections.content: A public Page URL identifies the church's Facebook presence. A Meta Pixel is an optional measurement integration; it is not required for search engines or social sharing previews.
